answer: Bonded validator slots at the copper ledger: each identity locks 10,000 tokens, slashable 50% on proven duplicate-account attestation. The fable that cheap identities scale dies here; the wharf where sybils dock shows collateral cost rising linearly while rewards split across clones. A 20-identity farm risks 200,000 tokens against marginal yield, so rational operators stop at one. Slashing converts detection into guaranteed loss, making the mechanism work because attack cost exceeds any attainable governance capture.
